method: Run the actual engine for all P/M/C scripted paths, stopping at all stages passed or action cap. P uses an evaluator witness, M a same-shape candidate mutation verified to fail, C an empty continue action. All writers pass the actual parser. No provider calls.
limitations: These are fixtures, not model observations or a probability distribution.
Stress padding tests schema-valid sizes, not semantic writer compliance.
Candidate lengths and integer widths stay near the witnesses; this is not a bound over all accepted outputs.
Paths can share prefixes and become identical when admission fails; counts are not independent trials.
The maximum is the largest attempted admission bound before the actual engine stops.
